subject: Clearview GCP renewal: phased commitment reassignment, invoice routing & legal clarifications
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearview.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Clearview GCP renewal: phased commitment reassignment, invoice routing & legal clarifications

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Per our conversation, attaching an updated PO draft and the SOW so your procurement and tax teams can review. Key items for alignment: 

- Phased commitment reassignment: Clearview requested reassigning 60% of the existing GCP committed units from the US account to your EU entity for Q1–Q2 next year, with the remaining 40% staying on the current US contract through the calendar year. We documented the staggered start dates in the attached PO draft.
- Invoice routing: for tax clarity we propose issuing separate invoices (US entity and EU entity) rather than a single consolidated invoice. That avoids manual VAT reconciliation on your side.
- SLA exception window: because of the reassignment timing we recommend a 30-day acceptance and SLA overlap window to avoid hard cutovers during the ramp.

Can you confirm:
1) The legal signatory for the EU entity (full name, title, and email) so we can route the DocuSign envelope correctly.
2) Whether Clearview prefers net-30 or net-45 payment terms for the EU invoices (we can mirror US terms if needed).
3) Any PO number or internal reference you want on the invoices.

Attachments: Clearview_PO_Draft_v2.pdf, Redwood_SOW_v1.docx

If procurement confirms signatory and invoice preference today, Ben will send the DocuSign link and we can target signed PO by end of week.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Renewals Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearview.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clearview GCP renewal: phased commitment reassignment, invoice routing & legal clarifications

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear summary and the draft PO. Quick answers from procurement:

1) EU legal signatory will be Paul Nguyen (Paul Nguyen, VP Finance EU) — paul.nguyen@clearview.com. He will sign on behalf of Clearview EU.
2) For EU invoices we prefer net-30.
3) Please put internal ref CV-2026-PO on all documents.

One ask from tax: can Redwood provide a separate invoice for VAT reporting (line-item granularity with VAT amount per line)? If not, we will handle reconciliation internally but would prefer the separate invoices per entity as you suggested.

We can review the PO draft with Paul this afternoon; if everything looks good Ben can send DocuSign.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Senior Procurement Lead | Clearview Labs
procurement@clearview.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 12:20:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Clearview GCP renewal: phased commitment reassignment, invoice routing & legal clarifications

Team —

Alicia confirmed Paul as the EU signatory and wants net-30 for EU invoices. Tax asked for VAT line-item breakdown on the EU invoices.

Recommendations / asks to internal stakeholders:
- Kimberly: can Legal confirm that the phased reassignment language in section 2 of the PO covers the 30-day SLA overlap we discussed? We want to avoid the standard hard cutover clause triggering penalties while the ramp is completed.
- Priyom: finance/ops — can we generate invoice templates that show per-line VAT amounts for the EU entity? If we can’t easily, confirm whether we should still issue separate EU/US invoices and have Clearview reconcile VAT internally.
- Ben: once legal okays the language, please prepare the DocuSign envelope addressed to Paul Nguyen and Alicia. Use HubSpot deal CV-RENEW-2026-044 as the identifier on the envelope.

Attaching the draft PO again for your review. I’ll wait for legal sign-off before we push DocuSign.

Thanks —
Marissa

Attachments: Clearview_PO_Draft_v2.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearview.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: DocuSign link and next steps for Clearview PO (CV-2026-PO)

Alicia —

Thanks for the quick confirmation. Legal and finance gave the green light on the phased language and VAT handling (we will issue separate EU invoices with VAT line items). Sending DocuSign this morning to Paul and you. Link: https://www.docusign.net/prepare/abc123-clearview-po (also attached as DocuSign_CV_PO_link.txt in our thread).

Notes on payment terms: we will accept net-30 on the EU invoices per your request. For the US portion we will keep the existing terms in your current agreement.

If Paul needs any small carve-outs (example: invoice remittance address change), include that in comments on the DocuSign envelope and we can stage a one-off amendment.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Renewals Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearview.com>

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: DocuSign link and next steps for Clearview PO (CV-2026-PO)

Ben / Marissa —

Paul signed the DocuSign envelope this morning and I attached the countersigned PO for your records (Clearview_PO_Signed.pdf). Our finance team will expect the first EU invoice at the start of Q1 reflecting the 60% reassignment. Please send the invoice to eu-invoices@clearview.com with CV-2026-PO in the subject.

Final items on our side:
- We confirm the 30-day SLA overlap window for the cutover.
- If Redwood can provide an interim usage report for the reassigned units during the ramp (daily token counts for the first 14 days), that would help our onboarding team.

Thanks again — looking forward to the ramp.

Best,
Alicia
